{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "summary": "An intimate, low-scale architecture about two sisters rebuilding trust after a fire. The proposal deliberately leaves genre, setting, cast, and concrete events unknown. It offers a relational engine of unequal need and practical care, a structure of small reparations, and an emotional progression from guarded grief to a partial, earned trust.",
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "repair_engine", "title": "Repair engine", "category": "engine", "summary": "Every offer of help is also a risk of reopening the injury, so repair advances through small, reversible acts rather than a single reconciliation."},
    {"id": "asymmetric_need", "title": "Asymmetric need", "category": "thread", "summary": "The sisters need different things from the relationship, so care cannot be symmetrical and trust must be negotiated."},
    {"id": "shared_work", "title": "Shared work", "category": "structure", "summary": "Practical cooperation gives the sisters evidence about each other that conversation alone cannot supply."},
    {"id": "small_reparation", "title": "Small reparation", "category": "trope", "summary": "A modest, repeatable act of care matters more than a grand apology."},
    {"id": "memory_of_fire", "title": "Memory of the fire", "category": "theme", "summary": "The fire is a shared history whose meaning each sister has organized differently."},
    {"id": "practical_care", "title": "Practical care", "category": "theme", "summary": "Love becomes credible through ordinary maintenance rather than declarations."},
    {"id": "guarded_grief", "title": "Guarded grief", "category": "reader_experience", "summary": "The reader feels grief held at a distance, with relief and wariness arriving together."},
    {"id": "earned_trust", "title": "Earned trust", "category": "reader_experience", "summary": "Trust becomes believable because it is built from repeated, imperfect evidence."}
  ],
  "links": [

    {"id": "fire_grounds_grief", "source": "memory_of_fire", "target": "guarded_grief", "function": "gives the guardedness a shared history"},

    {"id": "anger", "emotion": "anger", "role": "contrasting", "intended_effect": "Anger at old injuries that were never acknowledged.", "eliciting_condition": "One sister's version of the past erases the other's loss.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Sharp, specific disagreement inside an otherwise quiet scene.", "provenance": "agent_proposed"},
